_comment: Settings for the copy of the application the pipeline starts to run the browser-driven suite against (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=ci). Nothing here is a secret: the identity values are placeholders that never sign anyone in, and the content source and the assessments service point at tests/FipsFrontend.Tests.StubCmsApi. The Notify values are placeholders only - the client has no address to redirect, so a form that sends e-mail would reach the real service and be refused; the suite does not submit those forms (its two submitting tests are ignored), and the forms leave with #315. The same file serves a local run of the published output under the same environment name.
